channel.title: Beyonc? at the BBC
channel.desc: To celebrate Beyonc? reaching her fortieth birthday, this gift to her fans takes a trip through the archives for a selection of the best of Queen Bey at the BBC. The collection shows why everyone is 'Crazy in Love' with her and features several iconic live performances, with hits like 'Naughty Girl', 'Irreplaceable' and of course 'Single Ladies', underlining how she has become one of the biggest musical stars on the planet.
